description: Median best heavy-atom RMSD (Kabsch+Hungarian, adaptive centroid pre-alignment) of Vina redocked poses vs crystal ligand pose across 5 pockets x 3 seeds x exhaustiveness=16. BD-9 m15 RMSD Phase 2 Vina redocking (canonical script). 13 of 15 grid runs MEASURED (3ny8 1/3 seeds).
scope: pocket-bound redocking benchmark (m15 redesigned per TODO-134)
source: TODO-134 (m15 redesign spec) + Wf-139 P1 (ref ligand SMILES extraction) + BD-9 m15 RMSD Phase 2 (this script)
sota_success_criterion: median_best_rmsd <= 2.0 A (Trott & Olson 2010 Vina paper convention); per-pocket success rate >= 80% (TransDiffSBDD reference: 83.9%)
note: Wf-246-B redesign: per-pocket std reporting (13 MEASURED runs of the planned 15-run grid = 5 pockets x 3 seeds; 3ny8 succeeded on 1/3 seeds, all other pockets 3/3) + cross-pocket aggregate (median, std, min, max) + per-pocket difficulty flag (EASY <0.5A, MEDIUM 0.5-1.0A, HARD >=1.0A). Backward-compatible with Wf-179 ship schema.
